entities.name: Thanjavur Maratha Palace
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Thanjavur Maratha Palace, known locally as Aranmanai, today is the official residence of the Bhonsle family that ruled Tanjore from 1674 to 1855. It is located in Thanjavur, Tamil Nadu.
